variants.headline: Cyclone hits the colony
variants.body: A cyclone has hit the colony. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.body: A cyclone has reached {colony}. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
